title: Compiled build identity
responsibility: Hashes a build’s paths and content identities, ignoring embedded stamp values so stamping does not change the build identity.

inputs.name: buildIdentity.files
inputs.description: Each item supplies a forward-slash path inside the build directory and a sha256 content-digest string. The function sorts a copy by path before hashing and does not validate either field.

inputs.name: builtFileHash.bytes
inputs.description: Original bytes of one emitted file, held in a Node Buffer. Stamp normalization is attempted only when the bytes contain harness-build:.

outputs.name: buildIdentity
outputs.description: A lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the path and content-hash records, ordered by path. The function hashes the supplied strings as-is and does not validate that paths are unique or that sha256 values are valid digests.

outputs.name: builtFileHash
outputs.type: { sha256: string; stamps: string[]; slots: number }
outputs.description: Without harness-build:, sha256 hashes the original bytes; otherwise matching buildStampPattern strings are replaced with emptyBuildStamp() before hashing as Latin-1 bytes. stamps collects the buildStamp results for those matches, and slots is their count.
